note: Round 15 (2026-10-28): the operator: "for missing sounds, make sure they show up in the sound picker on the site, then generate a couple using our local model". A die roll tumbles from its card for 1.25 s, bounces twice and lands (live/dice.ts); g.die-roll plays as it is thrown, so a take is the whole throw: the rattle, a bounce or two, and the die settling, over in about a second and a half. A coin flipped in the game (Mana Crypt, Krark's Thumb) draws the toss's coin; g.coin-flip is its own slot so a coin flipped every upkeep need not be the once-a-game toss, and falls back to the toss (g.game-start, whose keepers are a coin flipped high and landing on a wooden table). Literal foley of the real object, the style most of the role picks came from (round 6); no bells, chimes or music.

g.die-roll.name: Die roll
prompts: A single plastic six-sided die thrown onto a wooden table, two quick bounces, a short rattle and it settles flat
One heavy resin twenty-sided die rolling across a felt-covered game table, soft tumbling clicks slowing to a stop
A bone die tossed onto an old oak tavern table, clattering twice and spinning briefly before it falls still
A metal die dropped onto a wooden board, a bright clack, a skittering roll and one last tap as it lands
A wooden die thrown into a leather dice tray, muffled thumps as it tumbles and settles
A small die cast onto a stone floor, a sharp click, a couple of hops and a dry rattle to a stop
